source_text: Sicut Iohannes dicit: haec scribo ut non peccetis; et si quis peccaverit, habemus advocatum apud Patrem Iesum Christum iustum, qui interpellat pro peccatis nostris. Ipsi gloria in aeterna saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: As John says: these I-write that not you-may-sin; and if anyone will-have-sinned, we-have advocate with Father Jesus Christ just, who intercedes for sins our. To-him glory into eternal ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: As John writes: [[I write this that you may not sin; and if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous, who intercedes for our sins >> Bible:1 John 2:1-2]]. To him be glory forever. Amen.
